results.snippet:
Troops of Operation Fansan Yamma have killed a suspected terrorist and arrested two others, a father and his son, over alleged links to the Lakurawa terrorist group in separate operations in Katsina and Sokoto states.

The operations, conducted on November 10 and 11, also led to the recovery of two AK-47 rifles, ammunition, a motorcycle and other items.
